_comment: Editor layout for ParameterTransformModel. Its catalogue entries hold a Python code: block rather than an equation:, which is two class attributes on the shared catalogue mixin rather than a second implementation -- so the picker is the same generic choice the parse models use. See okf/subsystems/gui-autoform.md.

sections.label: Transform
sections.description: Pick a transform; its code and initial parameter values are applied together.

sections.label: code
sections.description: The Python function. Its arguments become input parameters and its returns become outputs, which other fits can link to.
Inputs are editable; outputs are computed and stay fixed so other fits can link to them. Read from `_parameters` because this model holds them on its transform node rather than in `parameters_all`.
